notes.title: Anarkade is Available Now!
notes.content:
[b]Anarkade [/b]has launched! Step into the ultimate mix of anarchy and arcade action with this thrilling multiplayer arena shooter, now available on Steam. 

Get ready for intense matches where strategy and quick reflexes are key. Each arena brings its own challenges and chances to outsmart your opponents. Equip a wide range of weapons and customize your character for a personal touch—or tactical advantage! 

To celebrate the launch, we’ve just pre-recorded a special stream: [b]BFS Marketing vs. BFS QA[/b]. Watch as our teams go head-to-head and showcase the chaotic fun that Anarkade delivers! 🎮🔥

Battle with friends or foes online and dive into the chaos that [b]Anarkade[/b] brings. Join now and enjoy a [b]20% launch discount[/b] for a limited time.

Don't miss out—start your battle and dominate the arena today!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517800/Anarkade/

notes.content:
Tune in to watch BFS Glam! and BFS c4rlo as they sit down with the developers of [b]Anarkade[/b] in this pre-recorded 15-minute session! 

💥 Get an exclusive look at the story behind[b] Anarkade[/b], including insights into the pixel art style, music, and some fun behind-the-scenes moments from the development process.

notes.title: Anarkade is Launching September 23!
notes.content:
[b]Get Ready for Anarkade! [/b]🎮

We’re excited to announce that Anarkade will be launching on September 23! Prepare yourself for intense multiplayer action where you can battle online with friends, crush your rivals, and reign supreme in the ultimate arcade showdown.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Epic Multiplayer Battles:[/b] Engage in fast-paced, competitive multiplayer matches.
[*] [b]Online with Friends:[/b] Team up with friends or challenge them to see who’s the best.
[*][b]Customize Your Chaos:[/b] Make your mark in the wasteland with fully customizable characters. 
[*] [b]Vibrant Arcade Atmosphere: [/b]Immerse yourself in a retro-inspired, colorful arcade world.
[*] [b]Regular Updates and Events:[/b] Enjoy new content and seasonal events post-launch.
[/list]
Wishlist Anarkade now and be the first to experience the chaos when it drops on September 23! 🚀

notes.title: Anarkade Live Stream for PAX Australia!
notes.content:
Join the developers as they play through the multiplayer demo for PAX Australia! Ask them any of your burning questions about the game, characters, and story! Anarkade is a Multiplayer Arena Shooter with 2D platforming mechanics that features multiple weapons, randomly generated arenas, and humorously bloody animations.
